title: Fairness for Unobserved Characteristics: Insights from Technological Impacts on Queer Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative review and theoretical analysis of algorithmic fairness challenges, synthesizing case studies and prior literature on privacy risks (e.g., facial recognition 'gaydars'), algorithmic censorship, unrepresentative language models, and disparate impacts in healthcare and employment.

Review of sociotechnical impacts and prior empirical studies regarding AI misgendering, biased toxicity detection systems disproportionately penalizing drag or trans discourse, and algorithmic exclusion in medical and mental health interventions.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
